facts.text: I am looking into getting a fitness tracker to help me stay on track with my exercise routine.

I think a fitness tracker could help me stay motivated.
I am leaning towards Fitbit because it focuses more on everyday fitness and wellness.

I am concerned about the price point of the Lululemon The Mat.
I think the Manduka eKO SuperLite could be an alternative to the Lululemon The Mat.
